_about: WOKING 800 (McLaren Senna): its driver display (a_int_screen) and the portrait screen on the centre (a_intscreen2) are blank in the model (plain materials, no picture), so each gets a board laid on it, measured from its faces (rays from the driver's eye; m from the steering wheel's centre, the model's axes: x right, y up, z back): a digital cluster in McLaren orange, the centre screen's pages.
